assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: standalone phone app mockup for a website.
Input image is the edit target: the approved cymba laptop-and-phone product visual.
Primary request: extract and recreate ONLY the exact upright smartphone on the right as one standalone full phone. Remove the laptop completely. Keep the phone's hardware, front-facing orientation, dark interface, precise layout, typography, charcoal panels, lavender controls, teal pulse trace, purple brain trace and every visible label unchanged. Do not redesign the UI.
The phone screen must retain cymba, Demo, Deep work, Design the next iteration, 24:18, Session time, Personalised timing active, Brain activity, Pulse, This session, 0, 10, 20, Now, Pause, End, Park a thought, and bottom Session / History / Settings. Preserve their relative positions, the waveform panels, the session event strip and original icons.
Composition: very tall portrait image approximately 1:2 aspect ratio. One full smartphone centered upright, occupying 90–92% of image height and close to the image width. Tight even white margins about 4–6% around the full hardware outline. Full top and bottom of phone visible. Soft subtle contact shadow underneath on pure white #ffffff background.
No laptop, no second phone, no floating extra UI, no added text or labels, no watermark, no hands. The result must be a faithful separate-device version of the reference, not a newly styled app.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: standalone laptop app mockup for a website.
Input image is the edit target: the approved cymba laptop-and-phone product visual.
Primary request: remove the smartphone completely and recreate ONLY the exact full laptop, preserving the silver chassis, front-facing orientation, display bezel, keyboard, camera angle, dark interface, precise layout, typography, charcoal panels, lavender controls, teal pulse trace, purple brain trace and visible labels. Reconstruct the small screen area previously hidden behind the phone coherently by extending the existing Live signals / Pulse panels and existing recent-session cards. Do not introduce new features or panels.
Retain screen content: cymba; Session / History / Insights / Settings sidebar; Earbuds connected; Deep work; Demo data; WORKING ON; Design the next iteration; 24:18; Session time; Personalised timing active; Pause; End session; This session; Stimulation; Sensing; Timing adapts to your brain and pulse signals.; Park a thought; Live signals; Good contact; Brain activity; Pulse; Signals guiding session timing; This week; 6h 20m; Session time; Pick up where you left off; System design; Next: compare two approaches; 38 min; Reading & research; Next: finish the final section; 26 min.
Composition: landscape image approximately 3:2 aspect ratio. Full laptop centered and filling the frame, with tight even white margins of approximately 4–6% around the hardware. Preserve the complete lid, screen, keyboard and base—nothing cropped. Pure white #ffffff background and soft subtle contact shadow underneath.
No phone, no extra device, no floating extra UI, no added features, no watermark, no hands. Faithful separate-device edit of the reference, not a redesign.
